title: Requirements-to-design and future-validation links
status: Proposed traceability; no application acceptance scenario executed
interpretation: A linked scenario exercises selected aspects of a requirement, not exhaustive coverage. Every requirement also has textual acceptance criteria. Empty scenario lists identify dedicated case-design gaps, not waived requirements. Broader school scenarios may require extensions beyond the bounded one-provider/work-block domain model.
